# Editorial Silence

## Overview

Restrained elegance with magazine typography and generous whitespace. A calm editorial system where hierarchy comes from type scale, measure, and deliberate silence.

Generated by web-stylebook-mcp from the editorial-silence style. Values are the starting tokens compose_design_tokens returns without a visual contract. This file describes the light theme.

Visual profile: serif rhythm, paper-white surface, long-form spacing.

## Colors

Token names follow DESIGN.md conventions; the name in parentheses is the compose_design_tokens role.

- **primary** (text) `#1c1c1e`: Body text and headings.
- **on-primary** (textInverse) `#ffffff`: Text on a primary (ink) fill.
- **secondary** (textMuted) `#656566`: Secondary text: captions, metadata, helper text.
- **surface** (canvas) `#ffffff`: Page background.
- **surface-container** (surface) `#f8f8f8`: Panels and cards.
- **surface-container-high** (surfaceRaised) `#f4f4f4`: Raised surfaces such as inputs, menus, and popovers.
- **surface-variant** (surfaceMuted) `#ededed`: Muted fills such as hover rows, wells, and disabled areas.
- **outline** (borderStrong) `#a4a4a5`: Control boundaries that must stay visible.
- **outline-variant** (border) `#cdcdce`: Dividers and decorative rules.
- **accent** (accent) `#1c1c1e`: The style's identity accent.
- **on-accent** (accentText) `#ffffff`: Text on the accent.
- **focus** (focus) `#1c1c1e`: Focus indicator.

Status colors (positive, caution, critical, info) are not in this file; take them from compose_design_tokens.

## Typography

Intended type: Serif headline with quiet sans body. These levels are starting points; confirm the faces against the intended type before use.

- **display**: 'Noto Serif KR', serif, 3rem, line height 1.2
- **heading**: 'Noto Serif KR', serif, 2rem, line height 1.2
- **subheading**: 'Noto Serif KR', serif, 1.125rem, line height 1.5
- **body**: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif, 1rem, line height 1.5
- **small**: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif, 0.875rem, line height 1.5
- **caption**: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif, 0.75rem, line height 1.5
- **data**: ui-monospace, monospace, 0.875rem, line height 1.5

## Layout

Spacing tokens: 1 4px, 2 8px, 3 12px, 4 16px, 6 24px, 8 32px, gutter 24px, row 40px.

### Page structure

- **Opening:** A flush-left masthead in a 980px reading canvas, framed by a 2px ink rule above and a 1px #d4d4d4 hairline below: the eye lands on a serif h1 capped at 14ch with text-wrap: balance, which leaves the right half of the canvas empty, and one muted deck sentence follows. The product shows itself as text rather than imagery (the opening paragraphs of a real essay, doc page, or case study, or a dated contents list with reading times), and the only action is one text link set off by a 1px hairline.
- **Grid:** One centered canvas, min(980px, 90vw), with no column grid: running text holds a 62ch measure, and the only splits are a 1.3fr/1fr pair with a 20px gap and a two-column sheet whose cells share 1px hairlines at zero gap. Sections open on the 2px-over-1px rule pair and sit 64px apart, and every split collapses to one column at 760px.
- **Density:** Low: 44px control rows, 20px stacks, 24-28px padding inside sheet cells, and body text at line-height 1.75, so one screen holds a headline, a deck, and a few paragraphs; blocks sit 22-36px apart and sections 64px apart.
- **Type scale:** Serif carries meaning and sans carries apparatus: the h1 runs 1.9-3.8rem (its top end is under four body sizes) at line-height 1.25 and -0.015em, section h2s 1.5-2.1rem, and list sentences fall back to 1-1.15rem at weight 400. Running heads, meta lines, and tags are 0.66-0.72rem uppercase sans tracked 0.2-0.28em, and figures are tabular numbers (01, N° 12) or large serif numerals.
- **Section order:**
  1. Masthead: rule pair, 14ch serif headline, one deck sentence, and a real opening excerpt
  2. § 02 opener with a serif h2 and 60ch deck, then long-form text with margin notes
  3. A two-column hairline sheet whose numbered running heads index features, specs, or chapters
  4. Journal-style entries for case studies or changelog posts, each with a meta line and reading time
  5. A numbered list of serif sentences naming next steps, ending in one ruled text link
- **Signature moves:**
  - Rule-pair section opener with § index: Gives a long single-column page a periodical's section cadence, so readers keep their place without boxes, icons, or color.
  - Margin notes beside a 62ch column: Puts sources, definitions, version caveats, or named customer results beside the claim they support, as proof a reader can check in place.
  - Running-head hairline reference sheet: Lays out features, specifications, or chapters as numbered entries that read like a table of contents, in place of icon cards.

### Must-haves on the article page

The style restyles these but never removes them; every first-screen item goes in the opening.

- **Author**: On the first screen: in the opening section or above it, before the first scroll. Name the author near the headline, with rel=author, itemprop=author, or a "By …" line.
- **Publication date**: On the first screen: in the opening section or above it, before the first scroll. Show the publication or update date near the headline, ideally in a time element.

## Shapes

Corner radius: sm 0px, md 2px, lg 4px.

## Components

Each component names its text color and the background it sits on.

- **body-canvas**: primary on surface
- **body-panel**: primary on surface-container
- **muted-panel**: secondary on surface-container
- **button-primary**: on-accent on accent
- **focus-ring**: focus — Focus ring color.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do: Stay in neutrals; carry emphasis with weight, size, and space. (style rule accent-hues)
- Do: Remove decorative icon tiles; let type, numerals, or rules carry the hierarchy. (style rule icon-tiles)
- Do: Replace the sans/monospace display face with the style's authored family. (style rule typeface)
- Don't: Centered hero over a gradient blob (pattern gradient-blob-hero)
- Don't: All-text centered stack (pattern centered-stack-hero)
- Don't: Stock-photo hero (pattern stock-photo-hero)
- Don't: Logo strip (pattern logo-strip)
- Don't: Generic “trusted by” band (pattern trusted-by-band)
- Don't: Icon feature cards (pattern icon-feature-grid)
- Don't: Testimonial carousel (pattern testimonial-carousel)
- Don't: Generic closing CTA banner (pattern closing-cta-banner)
- Don't: Generic SaaS page skeleton (pattern generic-saas-skeleton)
